design_rationale:
WORKLOG — task 0 of trade_up_desk (Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes).

STEP 0. Draw and asset ledger. scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0001_fine_jewelry_retailer/tasks/trade_up_desk --tasks 2 printed
{"task": 0, "key": "fine_jewelry_retailer/trade_up_desk/0", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 6]}
and {"task": 1, "key": "fine_jewelry_retailer/trade_up_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 4, 5]}.
This task is therefore a tree of three problems, and its three computations carry 5, 5 and 6 declared factors: the
revaluation takes 5, the least-spend correction takes 5, the redemption takes 6. Nothing was occupied before this
task. It claims the revaluation of an issued credit, the correction of the least the customer must spend, and the
spending of credit against a sale, with their three tools. Left for task 1: everything before a credit exists at all
(the appraiser's valuation of a traded piece and the issue of the credit) and everything that closes a registration
without spending it (expiry, forfeit and the withdrawal of the traded piece) — three quantity-bearing writes on
separate event types, enough for its own tree of three problems with its own owner=user write.

DESIGN THESIS. Surface goal: "put the credit from my old ring onto the ring I am buying now". Scored core: the credit
actually applied at the till. Between them the policy puts two problems the customer never mentions: the credit
standing on her registration has not been revalued although a current appraisal supports a higher figure and the
programme's window is still open, and the figure printed on her registration as the least she must spend was worked
out on the day of issue and no longer answers to the credit the entries carry. The chain is forced: the revaluation
changes the credit standing, the credit standing changes the least she must spend, and the least she must spend
changes the part of her purchase that counts as spent above it, which is part of what is released onto this sale.

WHY IT MAKES A GOOD TEST. Nothing here is found by picking the right tool: all three tools are hidden and each is
named by exactly one policy. The difficulty is in reading out of the policy that a result waits on a state, checking
the records to find that state absent, and then reconstructing three numbers from a ledger, a tier ladder, two other
product registers and a set of dated windows. An agent who books the spend straight away writes 3420.00 instead of
4442.00 and the terminal hash differs; an agent who finds only the computation documents writes 3840.00.

STEP 0 CARD 1 — base invariants. tradein_credit_grant governs the revaluation write: grantable_state ("Credit is
booked, and later revalued, only while the registration stands at credit issued or partially redeemed") holds
because tradein_credits.status is partially_redeemed at the opening; revaluation_window is a time gate whose anchor
is tradein_credits.issued_date = 2026-04-01, whose duration is variants.revaluation_window_days = 90 for the Bridal
Upgrade Guarantee, counted in whole calendar days with the issue day as day zero, relation not_after, boundary
inclusive: 2026-04-09 is day 8, inside; day 90 is 2026-06-30 and still inside; day 91, 2026-07-01, is outside and
the desk would book nothing. tradein_registration_eligibility and tradein_estate_purchase govern the registration
update, and neither carries an eligibility gate that applies to tradein_registration_updated, so both are inherited
at policy scope. tradein_redemption and tradein_agg_credit_stacking govern the spend: redemption_bound_to_sale is
met by the till transaction BR-2026-330517 and merchandise line RING-62840 that the quoted coverage record carries,
spendable_state by the partially_redeemed status, and the stacking policy has no gate, so it is inherited at scope.
The registration's own entry conditions were checked too: the piece sold for 6400.00 against a 1999.00 minimum, it
was bought from the chain on BR-2019-204817, and it has been held since 2019-06-22 against a 180-day minimum.

STEP 0 CARD 2 — business object. The narrowest object is the registration TU-503914 (row initial_state.
tradein_credits.f405b339-b153-4130-8a82-75328f94b416), not the customer: the customer also holds TU-461330, closed as redeemed in 2022 with a
credit of 392.00 fully spent, and every aggregate in all three computations is scoped to the registration by its own
entries. Within the registration the entries are distinguished by family: the credit entry of 2026-04-01 is the one
the revaluation points back at, the valuation entry of 2026-03-30 is the only figure the registration's own entries
carry, and the spend entry of 2026-04-06 belongs to till transaction BR-2026-118342 and merchandise line EARR-20913,
which is why it can never be confused with the sale being settled now.

STEP 0 CARD 3 — problem tree. Root: tradein_ext_credit_redemption (the customer's own write, owner=user). Edge 1:
redemption waits on tradein_ext_upgrade_minimum_spend, kind value_input on the binding excess_spend, form state,
sentence "Credit is applied to a sale only after the registration carries the least the customer must spend worked
out against the credit as it now stands." Edge 2: the least-spend problem waits on tradein_ext_credit_revaluation,
kind value_input on the binding standing_all, form state, sentence "The least the customer must spend is fixed only
after the registration's entries carry every upward revaluation of the credit that the programme's window still
admits." Both sentences pass the four-point test: each joins this policy's own result to what it waits on with "only
after"; each waits on a record-visible state (a figure standing on the registration; a kind of entry standing among
its entries); neither names a tool, a policy id or any code token; and each is as strong and as wide as its edge.
For each, exactly one write of this difficulty brings the state about: only the revaluation problem books a
revaluation entry, and only the least-spend problem writes the figure the registration carries. Seed evidence for
their being false at the opening, the topological order and the deletion sensitivities are recorded in
prerequisite_closure. The order is forced by the chain, so there is nothing to reorder. Two of two edges are
value_input, above the floor of max(n-1, 1) = 1.

STEP 1. Policies. Three extended policies were written. tradein_ext_credit_revaluation declares no override: base
fixes no figure for the increase on a revaluation. tradein_ext_upgrade_minimum_spend declares one, naming
tradein_redemption's sentence "Credit is spent only against a new piece costing at least the programme's multiple of
the credit, and on the programmes that also require an uplift, at least that much more than the piece traded
originally sold for." and replacing it with its own: base would put the figure at max(6400 x 2, 6400 x 2) = 12800.00
in this world, the extended policy at 11805.00, so the divergence is declared clause by clause rather than left
implicit. tradein_ext_credit_redemption declares none: base fixes no figure for how much of a credit goes on one
sale. Every ladder is stated in full in the rule it belongs to, every baseline sentence is a verbatim sentence of
its own rule, and compute_basis quotes a rule sentence for every binding that reads the world, aggregates, chooses,
crosses a category, caps or rounds.

STEP 1 — FACTOR CARD (tier taken / evidence / baseline reading / figure under the baseline).
Revaluation, five factors. upkeep_certified_share (parameter, cross-difficulty on protection, multi-source): tier
"accepted certificate and two or more inspections inside twenty-four months", evidence the certificate on the
registration and the protection entries of 2024-11-08 and 2025-06-12; baseline the published 65 percent; 447.50.
supporting_value_basis (method, cross-difficulty on appraisal, multi-source): tier "the named report is inside the
validity window and the register carries a higher value", evidence AP-771402 issued 2026-03-30 and the register
entry of 10650.00; baseline takes the share on the original price; 0.00. revaluation_ceiling (parameter): tier "no
revaluation yet and issued inside sixty days", evidence the absence of a revaluation entry and the issue date;
baseline a tenth of the credit standing; 565.00. standing_credit_reading (method): tier "the credit entry was booked
on the original price and the chain sold the piece", evidence the credit entry's basis and the original receipt;
baseline reads the credit still available; 2480.00. appraisal_fee_offset (parameter, cross-difficulty on appraisal):
tier "the programme credits the fee and the report carries an amount still owed", evidence the 75.00 balance on
AP-771402; baseline takes the published 125.00 fee off; 930.00. Whole baseline: 0.00 against gold 980.00.
Least spend, five factors. membership_upgrade_multiple (parameter, cross-difficulty on circle, multi-source): tier
"Belrose Circle Gold with lifetime qualifying spend at or above twenty thousand", evidence the membership record's
tier and its 24800.00; baseline the published multiple of 2.0; 13275.00. ownership_uplift (parameter): tier "owned
at least five years and sold by the chain", evidence the 2019-06-22 purchase date and the original receipt;
baseline the published 100 percent; 12560.00. gain_measured_from (method): tier "the entries carry a valuation above
the original price and the chain sold the piece", evidence the valuation entry of 8900.00; baseline measures from
the original price; 9930.00. credit_standing_reading (method): tier "a spend stands and the programme allows partial
spending", evidence the spend entry and the programme's own flag; baseline reads the credit entries alone; 13305.00.
already_met_share (parameter): tier "the spends come to less than a quarter of the credit issued", evidence the
1500.00 of spends against 6400.00 issued; baseline treats nothing as met; 12555.00. Whole baseline: 14760.00 against
gold 11805.00.
Redemption, six factors. available_credit_reading (method): tier "a spend stands and partial spending is allowed";
baseline reads the credit issued; 4620.00. single_sale_share (parameter, cross-difficulty on circle, multi-source):
tier "one credit per sale and a membership above Belrose Circle Silver"; baseline 60 percent; 3266.00.
return_window_holdback (parameter): tier "issued inside the return window with an inspection on the registration",
evidence the 2026-04-01 issue date against a fourteen-day window and the inspection entry; baseline holds nothing
back; 4942.00. above_minimum_release (parameter, cross-difficulty on protection): tier "the price reaches twice the
credit still available and cover stands quoted"; baseline releases nothing; 4204.00. new_piece_price_reading
(method, cross-difficulty on circle): tier "a merchandise sale stands for the current month and cover stands
quoted", evidence the loyalty entries of 2026-04-06 and 2026-04-09; baseline reads the least she must spend;
4204.00. excess_spend_measure (method): tier "the least she must spend stands above the credit still available and
the credit has longer than a month to run", evidence the 2028-03-31 expiry; baseline adds nothing; 4204.00. Whole
baseline: 3840.00 against gold 4442.00. Every factor moves the result, and none of them rests on a field naming its
own outcome: tradein_credits.condition_grade and tradein_credits.appraised_value exist on the record but no rule
reads them, and the appraised value the registration carries (8900.00) is deliberately not the figure the register
carries (10650.00).

STEP 3. World. Why each class of row exists, and what changes if it goes. The registration TU-503914 is the object
of all three writes. Its four entries carry the reconciliation: remove the credit entry and the credit standing
falls to nothing; remove the spend entry and the credit standing, the already-met share and the reading of the
credit still available all change; remove the valuation entry and the gain is measured from the original price
instead; remove the inspection entry and 1500.00 is held back instead of 500.00. The closed registration TU-461330
is the excludable neighbour that proves the aggregates are scoped to one registration. The appraisal register
carries two reports for the traded piece: AP-771402, issued 2026-03-30 at 10650.00 with 75.00 still owed, which is
what the revaluation rests on, and AP-660941 from 2023 at 7200.00, which is lower and expired; remove the current
one and the share is taken on the original price. The protection file carries the pendant's plan with three
inspections, of which the 2024-01-15 one is the planted near-miss — twenty-six whole months back against a
twenty-four month window, so a careless reader counts three and takes the same tier for the wrong reason; and the
care plan standing quoted on the new ring, which carries the till transaction and merchandise line the credit is
applied to and whose absence would drop the released part to nothing. The loyalty account carries the tier and
lifetime spend the multiple and the single-sale share rest on, and two merchandise sales this month, of which the
earlier one (2850.00 on the earrings) is the second near-miss: a reader who takes the largest, or the first, rather
than the most recent, still lands on 12400.00 here but would not elsewhere, and a reader who takes the sum gets
15250.00 and a wrong release. No stale cache was designed into this task; tradein_credits.remaining_credit agrees
with the entries at the opening (6400.00 - 1500.00 = 4900.00), and the stale figure is deliberately the recorded
least the customer must spend, which is a prerequisite rather than a cache trap. Base automatic clauses were
checked: the credit does not expire until 2028-03-31, no forfeit is owed, the closed registration owes nothing, and
the protection and loyalty rows seeded for the cross-difficulty reads light no obligation in those difficulties —
the pendant plan is in force with its next inspection due 2026-06-12, and the quoted care plan has taken no premium.

STEP 4. Persona. Rosalind Ferraro speaks in specifics and does not push. She volunteers only the surface goal (the
credit onto the ring she is buying today), the identity details the desk needs, and her natural circumstances; every
business fact she states is entailed by the seed — the 2019 purchase from the Queens Road store, the laboratory
papers, the check-ups, the earrings a few days ago. She gives her mobile number at the opening, her date of birth
and her billing postal code only when asked to confirm who she is, and she has no reference number with her, so
TU-503914 must be found from the records. She never mentions a revaluation, an appraisal, or the figure printed on
her registration, and her only reaction to either prerequisite is to say to go ahead and wait. She runs the handed
over step herself. Her last reaction answers the last gold action and asks for nothing beyond it.

STEP 5. Verification. The computations were recomputed at handling time with the skill's own evaluator over
initial_state plus the earlier gold writes replayed through the real tools: revaluation 980.00 at step 11 on the
opening world; least spend 11805.00 at step 13 on the world after the revaluation; credit applied 4442.00 at step 15
on the world after both. Per-factor baseline substitution gave the sixteen figures recorded in
computations[].factor_sensitivity, all different from gold; substituting every factor's baseline at once gave 0.00,
14760.00 and 3840.00. Prerequisite sensitivity: skipping the revaluation write recomputes the least spend at
10825.00 rather than 11805.00; skipping the least-spend write recomputes the credit applied at 4204.00 rather than
4442.00; skipping both gives 3420.00. The terminal registration after the three writes reads status
partially_redeemed, remaining_credit 1438.00, upgrade_minimum_spend 11805.00 and redemption_receipt_number
BR-2026-330517.

STEP 6. Evaluation and closure. Sixteen actions: the customer lookup and the identity check, eight reads that reach
every row a factor rests on (the registration, its entries, both appraisal registers, both protection records, the
membership and the loyalty entries), and then three unlock/call pairs in the tree's topological order — the
revaluation, the least-spend correction, and the customer's own spend. policy -> target_tool -> computation ->
GT call -> terminal state closes three times over: tradein_ext_credit_revaluation ->
apply_credit_revaluation_37908854 -> revaluation_amount at step 11 -> the revaluation entry and the raised credit;
tradein_ext_upgrade_minimum_spend -> update_upgrade_minimum_spend_70148cfb -> upgrade_minimum_spend at step 13 ->
the corrected figure on the registration; tradein_ext_credit_redemption -> spend_upgrade_credit_c2e2bb76 ->
credit_applied_amount at step 15 -> the spend entry, the lowered credit and the part-spent status.
charter_scope.extended_policies equals the set of computation policy ids and required_documents repeats it in order.
No handover is written and no policy obligation is left open.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. Setting the yaml, compute, expected and gold aside: from the published
prose a reader learns that credit is applied to a sale only after the registration carries the least the customer
must spend worked out against the credit as it now stands, and that the least the customer must spend is fixed only
after the entries carry every upward revaluation the window still admits. The records show a registration whose
recorded figure, 12800.00, is exactly twice the credit as issued and so cannot answer to entries that now carry a
spend; and entries carrying no revaluation while a report issued two days before the credit and ten days before the handling date values the piece at
10650.00 and the window runs ninety days from 2026-04-01. Working forward: 10650 x 70 percent = 7455, less the 6400
of credit entries = 1055, under a ceiling of the whole credit standing, less the 75 still owed = 980. Then
6400 + 980 - 1500 = 5880 standing; 5880 x 1.75 = 10290; the gain 8900 - 5880 = 3020 at 75 percent = 2265; less half
of the 1500 spent = 750; 11805. Then 5880 at 80 percent = 4704; the ring at 12400 is 595 above 11805, two fifths of
which is 238; less 500 held back; 4442. The draft agrees with gold at every step, and no second reading of the
visible prose reaches a different figure: each ladder's tiers are disjoint as stated and the customer sits on
exactly one tier of each.

PER-TASK GATES RUN AFTER TASK 0 CLOSED (commands from the repository root, DIFF=env/env_0001_fine_jewelry_retailer/tasks/trade_up_desk).
check_extended.py DIFF --task 0 -> "EXTENDED gate (category=tradein, extended_policies=3, cross-cat=3, task_tools=3,
tasks=1, selected_task=0, no_handoff=True) [PASS] ... EXTENDED OK".
check_task_tools.py DIFF --task 0 -> "TASK-TOOL-CONTRACT gate (3 tools) [PASS] ... TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK".
replay_tasks.py DIFF --task 0 -> "0.json 16 acts det=True nonvac=True errs=0 clos=26 init=26 match=True ... REPLAY OK".
check_solvability.py DIFF --task 0 -> "0.json verify=True calls=3 base gates=7 seed rows=8 ok=True ... SOLVABILITY OK".
check_compute.py DIFF --task 0 -> "0.json comps=3 fact=16 xfac=7 hist=11 brch=54 step=16 match=True ... COMPUTE OK".
check_grounding.py DIFF --task 0 -> "0.json idAttrsUsed=3 answers=3 writes=3 cond=12 ok=True ... GROUNDING OK".
check_cross_fire.py DIFF --task 0 -> "SCOPE gate (1 tasks, policies=3, hard-fails=0) [PASS] ... SCOPE OK".
check_cache_diff.py DIFF --task 0 -> "CACHE-DIFF INFO (optional; no correctness gate)"; it reports remaining_credit
4900.00 against a zeroed history read and notes the absence of a cache re-check reaction. That is expected here: this
task designs no cache trap, and tradein_credits.remaining_credit agrees exactly with the entries at the opening.

MANUAL VALUES GATES FOR TASK 0. Length and breadth: the walk is surface goal -> "credit is applied only after the
registration carries the least the customer must spend worked out against the credit as it now stands" -> that figure
is fixed only after the entries carry every revaluation the window admits -> the revaluation, which rests on the
appraisal register, the protection inspections and the fee still owed. Removing either edge changes a scored number
(4204.00 and 10825.00 respectively), so neither is decorative. One problem of the tree, the spend, is the customer's
own: putting her credit toward her own purchase is hers to dispose of, it is unlocked and handed over, and it
completes at the counter within the same frozen_time. Need and simulator boundary: the persona fixes the object (the
ring being bought today), the timing (now, not a later visit), the authorisation (the desk acts on its side, she runs
the handed-over step) and that a write is wanted rather than a quote; she reads no policy, corrects no figure and
never names a prerequisite. Chronology: every fact she volunteers points at a seeded row, and nothing she says
foresees a figure gold writes. Base eligibility and the time anchor were checked verbatim against the anchor,
duration, counting rule, direction and inclusive boundary, with the day-90 and day-91 cases written out in
temporal_feasibility.boundary_check. Authoritative facts: the till transaction and merchandise line come from the
quoted coverage record, not from the caller; the credit standing comes from the entries, not from the cached field.
Reachability: every must-ask question (who she is, what she is buying, which registration) has a definite answer in
the persona or the records, and nothing waits on a real-world event. Prerequisite sentences: both pass the four-point
test, both use the state form because a record-visible state carries each edge, and for each exactly one write of this
difficulty brings that state about. Rule and compute were swept both ways binding by binding. Factors: every ladder
partitions on evidence the trade genuinely weighs for the quantity it decides, no two tiers of a ladder share an
outcome, the fall-through of each is the published baseline, and each customer condition rests on seeded rows rather
than on a stamp. The draft recomputation from the visible context, recorded above, reaches gold at every step.

REWORK ROUND 2 (source-layer audit, audits/policy_task/trade_up_desk). F-1: the three rules of this task's policies
now carry the qualifier "that moves the credit" on every "sum of every entry booked to the registration" sentence,
and each carries one defining sentence — an entry moves the credit where it books, revalues, spends or takes it away;
a valuation or inspection entry moves nothing — so the rule, compute_basis and every ladder read the same four
families and the 8900.00 valuation entry can no longer be read into the credit standing (the rival readings 25115.00
and 11324.00 are closed off; gold stays 11805.00 and 4442.00). F-2: the redemption rule now says the price of the new
piece is the spend recorded against the loyalty account's most recent merchandise sale, which is what compute,
compute_basis and the ladder always said. F-3: compute_basis.lab_report_value and .report_age_days now quote the
appraisal-register sentence they implement. O-4 (0.md item 4) is left as declared: the override names the base prose
clause the base formula implements, and the overwrite structure names clauses of a rule, not a formula key. O-5
(0.md item 5) is left as an observation: base fixes no amount for a revaluation, and the revaluation rule states its
own basis in one sentence. 0.md item 6: the day count in gold_actions[0].action_semantics now reads ten days before
the handling date. O-7: multiple_preferred is 1.4 (one and two fifths), so no programme's published multiple
coincides with a tier; this customer sits on the Gold tier (1.75) and no figure of this task moves. Gates were re-run
after the change and are recorded in the final report.
user_scenario:
You are Rosalind Ferraro, forty-four, a landscape architect in Charlotte who has bought from Belrose Fine Jewelers since her twenties and who talks about jewellery the way she talks about planting plans: slowly, in specifics, with a slight dryness. Five weeks ago you handed in the platinum solitaire from your first marriage under the bridal upgrade programme, and this morning you are at the counter of the Queens Road store with a platinum three-stone ring you have decided to buy. You have come through to the upgrade desk to get the credit from the old ring put toward it before the sale is closed off. That is the whole of what you want: the credit applied to the ring you are buying today, done by the desk now rather than left for another visit, and you are content for the representative to do whatever paperwork sits on their side of the counter. You have no idea how the credit is arrived at and you have never asked; you would only say that the old ring was a good stone and that the desk told you it would be worth having.

You open with the ring in front of you and the request in plain words, and you give your mobile number, 7045553517, because that is what you are always asked for. If the representative asks you to confirm who you are, you give your date of birth, 1981-07-14, and the postal code on your billing address, 28203; you know the email address and the mailing address on file as well, but you only offer those if the first two are not enough. You do not have the upgrade paperwork with you, so any reference number printed on it has to be found at their end, and you say so without embarrassment when you are asked for it. If you are asked what you are buying, you describe it as the platinum three-stone with the oval in the middle, and you mention that the sales assistant has already written it up and put a care plan quote against it. If you are asked about the old ring, you say it was bought from the Queens Road store in the summer of 2019, that it has its laboratory papers, and that it went in for its check-ups like clockwork. You remember putting some of the credit toward a pair of earrings a few days ago, and you will say so if it comes up, though you cannot remember the figure and will not guess at it.

You are unhurried and you do not press. Whenever the representative tells you that something on your record has to be brought up to date or worked out again before the credit can go on the sale, you say to go ahead and that you are happy to wait; you never ask what it is for and you never suggest what ought to be done. When the representative reads you a figure for anything, you take it as read: you have nothing of your own to check it against, and you say so if you are pressed. Once the representative has unlocked the step that only you can take and hands it over to you, you run it yourself, because putting your own credit toward your own purchase is yours to do, and you read back what comes out of it if you are asked. When you are told the credit has gone onto the sale, you thank them, say that is exactly what you came in for, and let the call end there.

gold_actions.business_effect: A revaluation entry of 980.00 USD is booked to registration TU-503914 and the credit still available to spend on it rises from 4900.00 USD to 5880.00 USD.

request_binding.action_semantics: The registration's credit was booked on the price the traded piece originally sold for while an insurance replacement report issued ten days before the handling date and two days before the credit values the same piece far higher, and the programme's revaluation window is still open; the uplift the records already owe the registration is booked before anything is measured against the credit.

discriminator.business_meaning: the credit standing on the registration falls short of the value the appraisal register carries for the traded piece

stage_provenance.fact: The upward revaluation of the credit is booked here and now, as one entry against the registration.

base_preconditions.condition: Credit is booked, and later revalued, only while the registration stands at credit issued or partially redeemed.

On the programmes that allow it, an issued credit may be revalued upward inside the programme's revaluation window, counted from the day the credit was issued, and the increase is booked as its own entry.

gold_actions.business_effect: Registration TU-503914 is made to read 11805.00 USD as the least the customer must spend for its credit to be usable, in place of the 12800.00 USD it carried.

request_binding.action_semantics: The figure printed on the registration was worked out against the credit as it stood on the day of issue; the credit the registration carries has since moved, so the record owes the corrected figure whether or not anyone asks for it.

discriminator.business_meaning: the least the customer must spend printed on the registration no longer answers to the credit its entries carry

stage_provenance.fact: The credit the figure is measured against is the credit standing once the revaluation booked at the earlier step is in the registration's entries.

boundary_check.just_before: Counting whole calendar days from 2026-04-01 as day zero, the bridal programme's window of 90 days runs to and including 2026-06-30; a revaluation presented on 2026-07-01, day 91, falls outside it and the desk would book nothing, leaving the credit as issued.
boundary_check.at_boundary: On 2026-06-30, day 90 exactly, the window is still open because the boundary is inclusive; the handling date 2026-04-09 is day 8, well inside it.

seed_consistency.check: The registration runs under the Bridal Upgrade Guarantee, whose entry gate asks a minimum original price of 1999.00 and a purchase from the chain: the piece sold for 6400.00 on receipt BR-2019-204817, and the customer has held it since 2019-06-22, far beyond the programme's 180-day minimum holding period. The credit issued, 6400.00, is the programme's 100 percent of that original price, under its 39999.00 ceiling; the credit still available, 4900.00, is that figure less the single 1500.00 spend booked; the status partially_redeemed follows from that spend on a programme that allows partial spending; the expiry 2028-03-31 is 730 calendar days from the issue date 2026-04-01; and the grade good is the grade the inspection entry recorded.

The closed standard trade-in is consistent on its own terms: the programme takes pieces the chain did not sell, so the receipt is empty and the original price zero; the credit 392.00 is 40 percent of the 980.00 appraised value at the excellent grade, which carries no condition deduction; the credit still available is zero against the single 392.00 spend booked, the status is redeemed and the closing date 2022-11-14 is the date of that spend. Nothing on it is live, so it adds no obligation this call must discharge.

The inspection was logged on 2026-03-06, the day after the piece was registered and while the registration stood open, which is when the charter admits an inspection; it moves no money, so its amount is zero, and the grade good it records is the grade carried on the registration and on the valuation entry that follows it.

The appraiser's valuation of 8900.00 was booked on 2026-03-30 on a current market appraisal basis, after the inspection and before the credit was issued, at the grade the inspection found and against the certificate GIA-4317208556 the registration carries; it is the figure the registration records as the appraised value.

The credit of 6400.00 was booked on 2026-04-01, the issue date the registration carries, on the original purchase price basis the bridal programme values on, and equals the credit the registration shows as issued; it is the only entry on this registration that books credit.

The earlier spend of 1500.00 was booked on 2026-04-06, after the credit was issued and while the registration was live, against till transaction BR-2026-118342 and merchandise line EARR-20913; it is negative because it takes credit out, it is the transaction the registration records as the last one spent against, and the loyalty account carries the matching merchandise sale of 2850.00 on that same receipt.

The credit of 392.00 on the closed standard trade-in was booked on 2022-10-12, the issue date that registration carries, on the current market appraisal basis that programme values on, and equals the credit it shows as issued.

The spend of 392.00 on the closed standard trade-in was booked on 2022-11-14 against till transaction BR-2022-771904, took the whole of that credit at once as a programme that does not allow partial spending requires, and closed the registration on the same date.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Select the one customer profile behind the caller from the mobile number she states, and read back the profile details the identity check is measured against.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Nothing on this call can be read or written before the customer's own record is identified; the registration, the entries, the membership and the coverage are all reached through this profile's reference number.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Measure the date of birth and the billing postal code the caller states against the profile on file and record the outcome of that check.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be cleared before any record of this customer's is read for money or written; two details agreeing is what the check requires.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every trade-in registration this customer holds: the live bridal registration with its programme, status, credit issued, credit still available, the dates it was registered and issued, its certificate, its appraisal reference, the grade the piece was found at and the least she must spend as it currently reads, alongside the closed standard trade-in.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The programme the registration runs under fixes every published figure used later, and the credit issued, the issue date, the certificate, the appraisal reference and the recorded least she must spend are read straight off this record; the closed registration is excluded because its credit is spent and its status is closed.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every trade-in entry booked for this customer and scope them to the bridal registration: the condition inspection, the appraiser's valuation of the traded piece, the credit entry with the basis it was booked on, and the spend already made against an earlier till transaction, alongside the two entries of the closed standard trade-in.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The credit already standing, the sum of the credit entries, the valuation the registration's own entries carry, the count of spends, the count of inspections and the basis the credit was booked on are all reconciled from the entries of the live registration alone, the two entries of the closed one being excluded by the registration they are booked to; the credit entry's own reference number is what the revaluation points back at.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the appraisal engagements on this customer's file: the current insurance replacement report the registration names, with its issue date, the value it states and what is still owed on it, and the older fair market report.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Whether the report the registration names is still inside the programme's validity window is decided from its issue date, and what is still owed on that report is what comes off the revaluation.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the valuation entries the appraisal register carries for the traded piece, together with the fee charged on the current engagement and the payment made against it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The highest value the appraisal register carries for the traded piece is what the revaluation share is taken on, and the fee and payment entries show why an amount is still owed on that report.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the coverage on this customer's file: the plan in force on the pendant she keeps covered, and the cover standing quoted against the three-stone ring she is buying today, which carries that piece's till transaction, its merchandise line and the value it was written up at.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Cover standing quoted decides how much of the spend above the least she must spend is released, and the quoted record is where the till transaction number and the merchandise line the credit is applied to are read from.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the entries on the coverage she holds, in particular every inspection logged against the pieces she keeps covered and the date each was logged.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: How many inspections fall inside the last twenty-four months decides the share of the current appraised value the revaluation rests on; the inspection logged in January 2024 falls outside that window and does not count.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the membership record: the tier held, the date it took effect, and the qualifying spend recorded over the life of the membership.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The tier and the lifetime qualifying spend decide the multiple the credit standing is taken at, and the tier decides the share of the credit that may go on one sale.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the points entries, in particular the merchandise sales the account records for the current month and the spend recorded against each of them.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Whether the account carries a merchandise sale this month, and the spend recorded against the most recent one, is how the price of the new piece is read.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the desk action that books an upward revaluation onto a trade-in registration so that it can be called.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock and call pair; it changes nothing in the records and is done once for this action.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book an upward revaluation of 980.00 USD onto registration TU-503914, raising the credit still available to spend from 4900.00 USD to 5880.00 USD and leaving a revaluation entry in the registration's history.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Only the revaluation policy's computation produces this increase, from the value the appraisal register carries for the traded piece, the share that value is taken at, the credit already standing, the ceiling for one revaluation and what is still owed on the report.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_reference: TU-503914 — the reference of the bridal registration whose credit is being revalued. Read from the registration lookup at step 2, where it is the only registration of this customer that is not closed; the closed standard trade-in carries TU-461330 and is spent, expired for spending purposes and beyond revaluation. Any agent who looks the customer up converges on the same reference.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.revaluation_amount: 980.00. The appraisal register carries 10650.00 for the traded piece (the insurance replacement report AP-771402), and the report the registration names was issued 2026-03-30, ten days before the handling date and well inside the programme's 365-day appraisal validity window, so the share is taken on that value rather than on the 6400.00 the piece originally sold for. The stone carries the certificate GIA-4317208556 and two inspections stand inside the last twenty-four months against the pieces the customer keeps covered (2024-11-08 and 2025-06-12; the 2024-01-15 inspection is twenty-six months back and falls outside), so the share is 70 percent rather than the 65 percent the programme publishes: 10650.00 x 70 / 100 = 7455.00, under the programme's 39999.00 ceiling. The credit entry on the registration was booked on the price the piece originally sold for and the chain sold the piece, so the credit already standing is the sum of the credit entries booked, 6400.00. 7455.00 - 6400.00 = 1055.00. No revaluation has yet been booked and the credit was issued 2026-04-01, eight days back and inside sixty days, so the ceiling for one revaluation is the whole of the credit already standing, 6400.00, which does not bite. The programme credits its appraisal fee against the upgrade and 75.00 is still owed on AP-771402, so only that 75.00 comes off: 1055.00 - 75.00 = 980.00.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.appraiser_code: APR-118 — the appraiser who valued the piece on the report the revaluation rests on. Read from the appraisal engagement at step 4, where AP-771402, the reference the registration names, carries APR-118; the older engagement AP-660941 carries APR-204 and its report expired on 2024-05-17. The tool's schema fixes the form as APR- followed by three digits.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_entry_id: 92c93790-c960-4e9e-8fbc-210922e8a275 — the entry on this registration that booked the credit now being revalued. Read from the registration's entries at step 3: it is the single entry of the credit booked family on TU-503914, dated 2026-04-01 for 6400.00 on the original purchase price basis. The inspection, the valuation and the spend entries book no credit, so no other entry can be the one revalued.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the desk action that records on a registration the least the customer must spend for its credit to be usable.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock and call pair; it changes nothing in the records and is done once for this action.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record 11805.00 USD on registration TU-503914 as the least the customer must spend for its credit to be usable, replacing the 12800.00 USD the registration carried from the day the credit was issued.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Only the least-spend policy's computation produces this figure, from the credit standing after the revaluation, the multiple the membership earns, the gain measured from the valuation the registration's entries carry, the uplift her length of ownership earns and what has already been met from the credit.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_reference: TU-503914 — the same bridal registration, read from the registration lookup at step 2; it is the only live registration this customer holds, and the figure recorded belongs to the registration whose credit it measures.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.upgrade_minimum_spend: 11805.00. After the revaluation is booked, the entries that move the credit on TU-503914 come to 6400.00 + 980.00 - 1500.00 = 5880.00; a spend already stands among those entries and the bridal programme allows the credit to be spent in parts, so the credit standing is read as that netted figure. The membership stands at Belrose Circle Gold with 24800.00 of lifetime qualifying spend, which is at or above twenty thousand, so the multiple is 1.75 rather than the 2.0 the programme publishes: 5880.00 x 1.75 = 10290.00. The registration's own entries carry a valuation of 8900.00, above the 6400.00 the piece originally sold for, and the chain sold the piece, so the gain is measured from 8900.00: 8900.00 - 5880.00 = 3020.00. She bought the piece on 2019-06-22, 2483 days before the handling date and so more than five years, and the chain sold it, so the uplift is 75 percent: 3020.00 x 75 / 100 = 2265.00. The spends booked come to 1500.00, less than a quarter of the 6400.00 credit shown as issued (1600.00), and the programme allows the credit to be spent in parts, so half of what has been spent, 750.00, is treated as already met. 10290.00 + 2265.00 - 750.00 = 11805.00.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the step the customer takes in person, putting her own upgrade credit toward the piece she is buying, and hand it to her.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Disposing of her own credit against her own purchase is the customer's to do; the desk unlocks it and hands it over rather than performing it, and the unlock changes nothing in the records.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The customer puts 4442.00 USD of her upgrade credit toward the three-stone ring on till transaction BR-2026-330517, leaving 1438.00 USD still available and the registration standing at part spent.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Only the redemption policy's computation produces this amount, from the credit still available, the share of it that may go on one sale, what is held back against the return window, the price of the new piece and the part of the spend above the least she must spend that is released.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_reference: TU-503914 — the registration the credit is spent from, read from the registration lookup at step 2; the customer's other registration is closed as redeemed and carries nothing to spend.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_applied_amount: 4442.00. The entries that move the credit come to 5880.00 after the revaluation, and because a spend already stands and the bridal programme allows the credit to be spent in parts, that netted figure is the credit still available. The programme allows one credit on one sale and the membership stands above Belrose Circle Silver, so the share that may go on this sale is 80 percent: 5880.00 x 80 / 100 = 4704.00. The credit was issued 2026-04-01, eight days back and inside the programme's fourteen-day window for taking the traded piece back, and the registration's entries carry a condition inspection, so 500.00 is held back. The loyalty account records two merchandise sales this month and cover stands quoted for the ring, so the price of the new piece is the spend against the most recent of them, 12400.00; the least she must spend now reads 11805.00, above the 5880.00 still available, and the credit has twenty-three months left to run, so the amount spent above the least she must spend is 12400.00 - 11805.00 = 595.00. That price reaches twice the credit still available (11760.00) and cover stands quoted, so two fifths of it is released: 595.00 x 40 / 100 = 238.00. 4704.00 + 238.00 - 500.00 = 4442.00.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.redemption_receipt_number: BR-2026-330517 — the till transaction the credit is put toward. Read from the coverage lookup at step 6: the cover standing quoted for RING-62840 was written on that till transaction on the handling date. The customer's earlier spend on this registration went to BR-2026-118342, which is a closed transaction from 2026-04-06 for a different piece, so the two cannot be confused. The tool's schema fixes the form as BR-, a four-digit year, a hyphen and six digits.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.redeemed_item_sku: RING-62840 — the merchandise line on that till transaction the credit is applied to, read from the same quoted coverage record at step 6, which covers that single piece. The traded piece is RING-51470 and the earlier spend went against EARR-20913, neither of which is the piece being bought. The tool's schema fixes the form as four letters, a hyphen and five digits.

edges.condition: The registration's recorded least the customer must spend answers to the credit the registration's entries now carry.
edges.policy_source: Credit is applied to a sale only after the registration carries the least the customer must spend worked out against the credit as it now stands.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At the opening the registration carries 12800.00 as the least the customer must spend, the figure fixed on the day the credit was issued against a credit of 6400.00 and before any spend or revaluation stood on it. The entries now carry a different credit, so the recorded figure does not answer to them; measured against 12800.00 the ring at 12400.00 would show nothing spent above the least she must spend, and the released part of the credit would be nothing.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The write of the least-spend problem replaces tradein_credits.upgrade_minimum_spend with 11805.00, the figure the credit standing after the revaluation calls for, so the amount spent above it becomes 595.00 and the released part becomes 238.00.

edges.condition: The registration's entries carry every upward revaluation the current appraised value supports while the programme's revaluation window is still open.
edges.policy_source: The least the customer must spend is fixed only after the registration's entries carry every upward revaluation of the credit that the programme's window still admits.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The registration's entries carry a credit entry, an inspection, a valuation and a spend, and no revaluation entry at all, while the appraisal register carries 10650.00 for the traded piece on a report issued 2026-03-30 and the credit was issued only 2026-04-01, so the programme's ninety-day revaluation window is open and the uplift the register supports has not been booked.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The write of the revaluation problem books a revaluation entry of 980.00 to the registration, so the entries that move the credit come to 5880.00 instead of 4900.00 and the credit leg and the gain are both worked out on that figure.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain, so only one order exists: the least-spend problem waits on the revaluation and the redemption waits on the least-spend problem. There are no parallel prerequisites to reorder. Running them in any other order changes the terminal state: booking the least the customer must spend before the revaluation records 10825.00 rather than 11805.00, and spending the credit before either records 3420.00 rather than 4442.00.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the least-spend write and replaying the rest leaves the registration reading 12800.00, so the amount spent above the least she must spend falls to nothing and the credit applied recomputes to 4204.00 instead of 4442.00; the terminal registration also still carries the stale 12800.00.

Skipping the revaluation write and replaying the rest leaves the entries that move the credit at 4900.00, so the least the customer must spend recomputes to 10825.00 instead of 11805.00, and the terminal registration carries neither the revaluation entry nor the raised credit.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario names neither prerequisite problem, neither of their figures and neither of their subjects. prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: None of the three tools validates a prerequisite. spend_upgrade_credit_c2e2bb76 looks the registration up by its reference and books the spend with the amount it is given, whatever the registration's recorded least the customer must spend says and whether or not a revaluation stands on it; update_upgrade_minimum_spend_70148cfb writes the figure it is given without reading the entries; apply_credit_revaluation_37908854 books the increase it is given without checking the window or the appraisal.
